name: project-launcher
description: End-to-end project launcher: research and context gathering, requirements interviews, PRD generation, critical gap analysis, project scaffolding, and GSD v2 handoff — plus rhize-visual-plan, a Rhize-owned .mdx visual-plan review surface (diagrams, wireframes, file maps, data/API contracts) rendered in Next.js and the Obsidian vault. Takes a project idea from napkin sketch to autonomous execution.
